'''Black Razor Cat''' was a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of the [[Hidden Daggers]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Black Razor Cat frequently raided the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]] in their [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wing interceptor]].<ref name="SWG:CS" />
{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateHiddendaggerPilots.jpg|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Black Razor Cat]]
Black Razor Cat appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:CS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Black Razor Cat was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]]. Black Razor Cat was a starfighter boss that had a low probability to spawn among a group of Hidden Dagger starfighters in the Corellian system.<ref name="SWG:CS" />
